xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5237: Composer: cancel a message while it shows Sending…

plan.title: Composer: cancel a message while it shows Sending…
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One client/server contract: the client cancel flow cannot be verified without the server's cancelled/delivered/unknown outcome, and the server gate and route have no user-visible effect alone. The surface is ~26 files only because each slice carries its own tests and the change touches docs, changelog and the frontend test subset list (each a separate path prefix).

narratives.Problem: A composer message in the Sending… state cannot be cancelled. Since PAN-5184 a message is Sending… while it waits in the per-conversation client send queue or while its POST /api/conversations/<name>/message is in flight (up to 120 s). Held messages only offer Discard, which loses the text.
narratives.Proposal: Server: the message receipt (conversation-message-receipts.ts) gains a delivery gate (isCancelled/commit) and cancel outcomes; deliverConversationMessage checks the gate before the pane work and commits immediately before every irreversible step (paste, Pi control channel, native compact, composer command); a new POST /api/conversations/:name/message/cancel answers cancelled | delivered | unknown and writes a tombstone for an id it has not seen. Client: bubbles carry sendPhase/sendRoute/cancelState; a shared runCancellableSend wraps the three send sites (deliverQueuedPrompt, releaseHeldMessages, retryFailed); cancelSend cancels queued and held bubbles locally and in-flight ones through the server, never aborting the fetch; a cancelled message's text goes back into the empty mounted composer through a registered restore target, otherwise to the outbox as Cancelled with Resend. See .pan/drafts/PAN-5237.md (D1–D10, WI-1..WI-7).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Cancelling /pan commands, scheduled (when-limits-reset) messages, held-kickoff starts or Shared Sessions prompts
- Cancelling an in-flight send to /api/agents/:id/message (that route has no receipts)
- Cancelling after the paste started: no un-paste, no Escape or other keys sent to the agent to undo input
- Aborting the in-flight HTTP request from the client (the AbortController stays timeout-only)
- Keeping the steer/follow-up delivery mode when a Cancelled entry is resent
- A new MCP tool or pan CLI verb for cancel
- Making composer bubbles survive a page reload
- Growing src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts beyond 1034 lines or raising any file-size allowlist cap

autoDecisions.summary: The client never aborts an in-flight POST it cancelled; it removes the bubble on a server 'cancelled' outcome and waits for the server's own 409 cancelled before the next queued send starts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue text says to abort the request, but the server has no per-conversation serialization: aborting would let the next queued message start while the cancelled handler may still send ensure-main keys (Down/Up/Enter/Escape) to the same pane, which can submit a partial paste and breaks requirement 5 (never reorder or disturb other messages).

autoDecisions.summary: The cancel route answers three outcomes: cancelled, delivered, unknown. An id the server has never seen gets a tombstone and the answer unknown.
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 'never claim a cancel that didn't happen': with no receipt the server cannot tell a not-yet-arrived POST from a receipt lost to a restart. The tombstone still refuses a late POST, whose 409 cancelled then settles the bubble truthfully.

autoDecisions.summary: A cancel is final once the server reaches its commit point (immediately before paste, Pi control-channel delivery, native compaction or a composer command); after it the answer is 'delivered' and the UI says "Already delivered, can't cancel".
autoDecisions.rationale: Cancelling between paste and Enter would leave text in the agent's input box; one synchronous commit per irreversible step is the smallest truthful boundary.

autoDecisions.summary: In-flight sends to /api/agents/:id/message show no Cancel control; they are cancellable only while queued or held.
autoDecisions.rationale: That route ignores clientMessageId and has no receipts, so a server-side cancel cannot be confirmed; adding receipts to agent messaging is a separate change.

autoDecisions.summary: Composer 'empty' means blank editor text, no pending attachments and no pending citations, and only a mounted composer (a registered restore target) can take text back; otherwise the message becomes a Cancelled outbox entry.
autoDecisions.rationale: The mounted Lexical editor rewrites the draft from its own latestTextRef on unmount (ComposerPromptEditor.tsx), so writing localStorage directly would be lost; a deterministic outbox fallback never drops the text.

autoDecisions.summary: On held (permission-pending) bubbles, Cancel replaces Discard and discardHeld is removed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 4 says held messages cancel the same way; Cancel keeps the text (composer or outbox, where Discard remains), so no capability is lost.

autoDecisions.summary: Offline-held outbox entries (PAN-4279) get a Cancel button that clears heldOffline and turns the entry into a Cancelled entry (or returns the text to the empty composer).
autoDecisions.rationale: They already sit in the outbox; cancelling them means stopping the automatic reconnect send, and clearing heldOffline is what makes flushHeldMessages skip them.

autoDecisions.summary: A Cancelled outbox entry has code 'cancelled', deliveryUnknown false, retryable true and a Resend button; Resend uses a fresh clientMessageId and the default delivery mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: deliveryUnknown false already makes retryFailed mint a fresh id (the receipt for the old id replays the 409 cancelled); the optimistic bubble never stored deliverAs, so preserving steer would need new plumbing outside this issue.

autoDecisions.summary: The plan stays one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The server endpoint has no user-observable effect without the client, and the client's acceptance tests depend on the server's outcome contract.

items.title: Receipts: delivery gate, cancel outcomes and tombstones

expected_outputs: conversation-message-receipts.test.ts passes including the new cancel and tombstone cases

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add phase 'pending'|'committed'|'cancelled' and nullable fingerprint (tombstone) to Receipt. Export ConversationDeliveryGate, OPEN_DELIVERY_GATE, ConversationMessageCancelOutcome and cancelledBeforeDeliveryResponse() (409 {error:'Cancelled before delivery', code:'cancelled', deliveryUnknown:false, retryable:false}). createConversationMessageReceipts() returns { deliver(name, body, run: (gate) => Promise<Response>), cancel(name, id) }: no clientMessageId -> run(OPEN_DELIVERY_GATE); a tombstone previous returns its result before the fingerprint check; cancel follows PRD decision D2 (pending -> cancelled; settled without commit -> cancelled; cancelled -> cancelled; committed -> delivered; unknown id -> write tombstone, answer unknown; tombstone -> unknown until a POST hit it and was refused (refusedPost), then cancelled; invalid id -> 'invalid'). Export singletons withConversationMessageReceipt = receipts.deliver and cancelConversationMessage = receipts.cancel, plus handleConversationMessageCancel(name, body, conversationExists) returning 404 / 400 / 200 {outcome}. The module must not import the conversation database. Update existing tests to call .deliver and add the PRD's cases with vi.useFakeTimers().

items.title: Given a pending receipt, when cancel(name, id) runs, then it returns 'cancelled' and the receipt's gate.commit() returns false and gate.isCancelled() returns true
Given a receipt whose gate.commit() already returned true, when cancel runs, then it returns 'delivered' (also after the receipt settles)

Given an id the receipts have never seen, when cancel runs (once or twice), then it returns 'unknown'; a later deliver() with that id returns 409 code 'cancelled' without invoking run, and a cancel after that returns 'cancelled'
Given a receipt that settled without calling commit (e.g. run returned 409 permission-pending), when cancel runs, then it returns 'cancelled'; an id failing ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$ returns 'invalid'
handleConversationMessageCancel returns 404 when conversationExists is false, 400 for an invalid id, and 200 {outcome} otherwise; a tombstone is pruned after 24 h of fake time so a new POST delivers
Delivery handler checks the gate before pane work and commits before each irreversible step

expected_outputs: the three conversation-message test files pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Add optional deliveryGate?: ConversationDeliveryGate to ConversationMessageDependencies (absent = OPEN_DELIVERY_GATE, so scheduled-message delivery and the Shared Sessions submit queue are unchanged). In deliverConversationMessage: commit before handleComposerCommandMessage when isComposerCommandMessage(message); commit before compactConversationNative; commit before deliverConversationViaControlChannel; isCancelled() check as the first statement of the non-Pi branch (before conversationPendingPermission and ensureMainInputTarget); one commit after the Kimi session wait and immediately before whichever deliver(...) call runs. Each failed check returns cancelledBeforeDeliveryResponse(). New test file stubs the dependencies like conversation-message-permission-hold.test.ts.

metadata.parallelSafeReason: It has no DAG predecessors and shares no file with the server items (receipt-cancel-gate, handler-delivery-gate, cancel-route) or the docs item; the client calls the cancel route by URL and its tests stub fetch, so it can run in its own slot beside them.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 steps 1-6 and the releaseHeldMessages/retryFailed parts of step 7. ChatMessage gains sendPhase, sendRoute, cancelState. composerSend.ts gains requestConversationMessageCancel(name, id): Promise<'cancelled'|'delivered'|'unknown'> (15 s timeout, throws on non-2xx or a bad body); sendConversationMessage is unchanged (no signal). composerStore.ts: module-level cancelledSendIds + restoreTargets with exported registerComposerRestoreTarget and consumeCancelledSend; sendPhase is opt-in: SendIdentity (composerEchoes.ts) gains sendPhase?: 'queued', and the only two addOptimistic callers (useStableComposerProps onSend and retryFailed) pass sendPhase 'queued'; a bubble without sendPhase (and not held) is never cancellable; markSendStarted(name, id, route?) sets 'in-flight' + sendRoute; exported runCancellableSend; new actions settleCancelled (idempotent; empty restore target gets the text, else a Cancelled outbox entry {code:'cancelled', retryable:true, deliveryUnknown:false}), cancelSend(messageId) (queued/held -> local; in-flight conversation route -> server; agent route -> no-op; never aborts the fetch), cancelHeldOffline(failedId); releaseHeldMessages and retryFailed (prompt kind) send through runCancellableSend. Keep discardHeld for now (bubble-cancel-controls removes it). resetComposerStore clears the new module state. Add composerCancel.test.ts to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

items.title: Given an in-flight conversation-route bubble, when cancelSend runs and the cancel POST returns outcome 'cancelled', then the bubble is removed, the later 409 code 'cancelled' from the message POST adds no outbox entry, and the message POST's fetch signal is never aborted

Given an in-flight bubble, when the cancel POST returns 'delivered', then the bubble stays with cancelState 'too-late'; when it returns 'unknown' or rejects, then the bubble stays with cancelState 'unconfirmed'

Given a held bubble, when cancelSend runs, then it is removed and releaseHeld posts nothing for it; given an offline-held entry, when cancelHeldOffline runs, then the entry has code 'cancelled' and no heldOffline flag

Given a registered restore target whose isEmpty() returns true, when a message is cancelled, then setText receives the message text and no outbox entry is added; with isEmpty() false the outbox gains a 'cancelled' entry
Given a Cancelled outbox entry, when retryFailed runs, then the POST body carries a new clientMessageId and no retry: true flag
deliverQueuedPrompt skips cancelled sends and runs through runCancellableSend

Pending bubble status text precedence: cancelling -> 'Cancelling…', too-late -> "Already delivered, can't cancel", unconfirmed -> "Couldn't confirm the cancel", deliveryState unknown -> 'Delivery not confirmed', else 'Sending…'; spinner only for Sending…, Delivery not confirmed, Cancelling….
